acs5_2024_vt_extract.csv.description: Vermont county (5-digit) and tract (11-digit) rows extracted from the ACS 2020-2024 5-year table-based Summary File
acs5_2024_vt_extract.csv.method: Streamed in a browser; kept GEO_ID prefixes 0500000US50 and 1400000US50 and the columns listed in census.ACS_VARIABLES. Column and row-weighted checksums verified against the source extract.

2024_gaz_tracts_50_landarea.csv.description: GEOID and ALAND_SQMI from the 2024 Census Gazetteer tract file for Vermont

vt_towns_2024.psv.description: Vermont county subdivisions (towns, cities, gores, grants): GEOID, name and internal point from the 2024 Gazetteer, with ACS 2020-2024 5-year population (B01003, summary level 060)

vt_counties_tigerweb.txt.description: Generalized Vermont county outlines (one line per county: GEOID|name|rings; '#' separates polygons, ';' separates rings)
